hypothesis: Check whether serializing marked catalog capture and ranking changes observed timeouts and stage overlap; no expected favorable conclusion
intervention: one diagnostic process-local mutex shared by marked actual_catalog_read_and_capture and retrieval_and_ranking outer spans
scope_limit: This also serializes capture/capture; it does not isolate a unique GIL, scheduler, network or SQL-lock cause
source_control: all four runs use the same clean commit and tracked source hashes; no tracked writes during measurements
execution: serial runs; no other local test, measurement or helper CPU jobs; no access to user service 8000
validation: exact child settings, shared timeline, client/server status association, successful identity and database traces; verify B has no overlapping marked business spans and retain all waiting/missing/failure records
stop_policy: Stop on infrastructure or trace-integrity failure; 504 is an outcome, not a reason to rerun. No automatic repetition, sample expansion or removal of an arm
interpretation: Report each run separately. Eight load requests per arm are exploratory, not stable performance or SLA evidence. Do not subtract observer overhead or add nested stages. Zero successes keep successful metrics null
